critical_question: How does code-generated, visually grounded 3D value-map composition enable closed-loop robot motion from language, and what limits the zero-shot claim when successful contact-rich manipulation instead uses generated trajectories to guide dynamics learning?
source_locator: Sections 3.1-3.4, physical pages 3-6; section-4 implementation and 4.1-4.4, pages 6-8; explicit limitations in section 5, page 8.
expected_relation: Visually grounded maps turn language into spatial objectives for repeated motion planning, supporting the tested manipulation and disturbance results. Contact-rich examples often need dynamics learning guided by those trajectories; their eventual success does not establish unrestricted zero-shot manipulation.
